root_cause: The mapper selects valid source paths but assigns the property name and location city to each other's target fields.
recommended_fix: Set name to p.property.name and city to p.property.location.city. Retain the existing rating conversion and country mapping.
validation_summary: Static review of the four validation cases yields two failures: name and city are swapped. The rating and countryCode cases pass.
field_mapping_findings: The name and city mappings are reversed: name receives property.location.city, while city receives property.name. The ID and countryCode mappings match the payload.
enum_conversion_findings: The FOUR_STAR value maps correctly to starRating 4. No enum conversion defect is identified in this case.
nested_structure_findings: The location.city nested path is valid, but it is assigned to the wrong target field. No other nested access defect is identified.

root_cause: The lookup keys do not match the supplier's underscore-separated enum values. Permissive defaults turn unmapped values into valid but incorrect platform enums, concealing the unsupported input.
recommended_fix: Add exact mappings for HALF_BOARD and NON_REFUNDABLE. Replace the misleading defaults with explicit handling that reports or rejects an unrecognized supplier value rather than assigning a different valid category.
validation_summary: Static review of four validation cases yields two failures: mealPlan and cancellationPolicy resolve to incorrect fallback values. The ID and price cases pass.
field_mapping_findings: The offer ID and both price fields are mapped from the corresponding payload fields. No direct source-to-target field mapping defect is identified.
enum_conversion_findings: HALF_BOARD and NON_REFUNDABLE are absent from their respective lookup tables, which use HALFBOARD and NONREFUNDABLE instead. The fallback values silently produce room_only and refundable, both incorrect for this payload.
nested_structure_findings: The rate object and its amount and currency fields are accessed correctly. No nested structure defect is identified.

root_cause: The mapper follows the nested departure path only as far as the airport object and omits the final code property. This produces an object where the target model requires a string.
recommended_fix: Change origin to leg.departure.airport.code. Keep the other nested paths and quote mappings, which match the supplied payload and target schema.
validation_summary: Static review of five validation cases yields one failure: segments[0].origin has an object value rather than the expected airport code. The ID, destination, timestamps, and total price cases pass.
field_mapping_findings: The trip ID, destination, timestamps, and total price map to their intended target fields. The origin value has the wrong shape for the target field: it receives the full airport object instead of the airport code string.
enum_conversion_findings: No enum fields are involved in this mapping, so no enum conversion defect is identified.
nested_structure_findings: The mapper traverses itinerary.legs and the nested departure and arrival objects successfully, but assigns departure.airport as an object. The target segments.origin field requires the nested departure.airport.code string.
